title: YieldSeeker
tagline: AI Agent that will find and execute the best yield options for you, automatically
description:
The Problem

Navigating Crypto Yields is Complex.
Crypto Yield Volatility: makes it difficult for even experienced investors to find the best opportunities.
New opportunities constantly emerging: requires continuous monitoring and research.
Understanding inherent risks: such as impermanent loss in liquidity provision, is crucial.
Personalized approach needed: Each investor has a unique risk tolerance and investment goals.
Decentralized DeFi complexity: makes fair comparison and evaluation of options challenging.

Our Solution
Yield Seeker uses advanced AI algorithms to analyze vast amounts of market data.
It identifies and recommends the highest-yield opportunities tailored to your personal risk tolerance.
Our agent streamlines the yield management process, automating the investment process.
Receive regular reports on your portfolio performance and yield optimization strategies.

Yield Seeker can automatically manage user portfolios to move USDC (and any asset in the future) to earn the highest yield. Our backtesting shows we can regularly achieve above-market rates.
how_its_made: YieldSeeker checks multiple sources of on-chain yield. It currently queries morpho and spark.fi on Base but is easily extendable to query any number of sources, which we will expand going forward. The app uses coinbases agentkit to expose an api hosted on autonome via a custom docker container. We've built and deployed it without elizaOS or similar, chosing to hand-code the agent for maximum optimisation. We use llms hosted on AWS bedrock. Each yield option is then analysed and assigned a propriety risk score from on-chain data. We use The Graph to host and query yield options and tokens.
